title: Booking a hotel room
instructions: Mr Kaya telefonda otel odası ayırtıyor. Tarihlere, oda türüne ve fiyata dikkat et.

script.speaker: hotel
script.text: Good morning, Sea View Hotel. How can I help you?

script.speaker: kaya
script.text: Hello. I'd like to book a room for three nights, from the tenth of June.

script.speaker: hotel
script.text: A single or a double room?

script.speaker: kaya
script.text: A double, please. I'm coming with my wife.

script.speaker: hotel
script.text: We have a double room with a sea view for ninety pounds a night.

script.speaker: hotel
script.text: Yes, it is. Breakfast is from seven to ten.

script.speaker: kaya
script.text: Great. Is there parking at the hotel?

script.speaker: hotel
script.text: I'm afraid not, but there's a car park next to the hotel.

script.speaker: kaya
script.text: That's fine. I'll take the room.

questions.prompt: How many nights does Mr Kaya want to stay?
questions.feedback: Üç gece (three nights) kalmak istiyor. On, haziranın onu.
questions.evidence: I'd like to book a room for three nights

questions.prompt: Why does he want a double room?
options: He is coming with his wife.
questions.feedback: Eşiyle geliyor (I'm coming with my wife).
Deniz manzaralı çift kişilik oda gecelik doksan pound.

questions.prompt: Where can Mr Kaya park his car?
options: in a car park next to the hotel
questions.feedback: Otelde otopark yok (I'm afraid not), yanındaki otoparka bırakabilir.
questions.evidence: there's a car park next to the hotel.
